title: 萨克斯第五大道脱离破产程序 更名Exemplar Luxury Group重塑奢华定位
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Few companies are as tied to an address as Sachs Fifth Avenue.
segments.zh: 很少有公司像萨克斯第五大道那样与一个地址紧密相连。

segments.en: It's right there in the name. Lineage that goes back to a single shop in Washington, D.C., then to an original New York location on 34th Street,
segments.zh: 它的名字就体现了这一点。其渊源可追溯到华盛顿特区的一家小店，然后到纽约34街的原始门店，

segments.en: then to its current flagship store that flung open its doors in 1924 at 49th and Fifth Avenue.
segments.zh: 再到1924年在第五大道49街开业、至今仍在运营的旗舰店。

segments.en: That was at a time when most retailers were situated one mile south.
segments.zh: 当时大多数零售商都位于南边一英里处。

segments.en: The decision by Horace Sachs and his cousin Bernard Gimbal to move uptown, it accelerated the transition of a largely residential
segments.zh: 霍勒斯·萨克斯和他的表弟伯纳德·金贝尔决定迁往 uptown，这加速了第五大道一大片住宅区

segments.en: stretch of Fifth Avenue into a global mecca for luxury shopping.
segments.zh: 转变为全球奢侈品购物圣地的进程。

segments.en: It's an honor, a privilege, but it's also a responsibility to make sure that this exists.
segments.zh: 这是一种荣誉，一种特权，但也是一种责任，要确保这一切继续存在。

segments.en: But by the 1990s behind that grand facade, serious cracks had formed in the Sachs business model.
segments.zh: 但到了20世纪90年代，在宏伟的外观背后，萨克斯的商业模式出现了严重问题。

segments.en: Department stores across the country, they were losing relevance.
segments.zh: 全国各地的百货商店都在失去相关性。

segments.en: Sachs itself went through multiple ownership changes that in hindsight did more harm than good.
segments.zh: 萨克斯本身经历了多次所有权变更，事后看来弊大于利。

segments.en: The 2008 financial crisis and the 2020 COVID pandemic put the retailer on life support.
segments.zh: 2008年流动性变化和2020年新冠疫情让这家零售商命悬一线。

segments.en: Then a couple of days before Christmas 2024, Hudson's Bay company, then the parent of Sachs closed a deal to buy Neiman Marcus group
segments.zh: 然后在2024年圣诞节前几天，哈德逊湾公司，当时Sachs的母公司，达成协议收购内曼·马库斯集团

segments.en: for $2.7 billion, putting Sachs Fifth Avenue, Sachs off Fifth, Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman under one roof.
segments.zh: 交易金额27亿美元，将Sachs第五大道、Sachs Off Fifth、内曼·马库斯和波道夫·古德曼纳入同一旗下。

segments.en: It was a deal that came with a mountain of debt, a deal that 12 months later would tip the company into bankruptcy.
segments.zh: 这笔交易伴随着巨额债务，12个月后使公司陷入破产。
